## Load and inspect data
```{r data}
data(pension)
pension <- pension
str(pension)
summary(pension)

```

## Define variables
```{r define vars}
# Outcome variable
Y <- pension$net_tfa 

# Treatment variable
A <- as.numeric(pension$e401)

# Covariates and control variables (for adjusting treatment effects)
X <- as.matrix(pension[, c("age", "inc", "fsize", "educ", 
                           "marr", "twoearn", "db", "ira", "hown")])

P <- pension[, c("age", "inc", "educ")]

```

## Question 2

```{r 2 AIPW}

# Set up superlearner
SL.library <- c("SL.glm", "SL.glm.interaction", "SL.ranger", "SL.gam")

# AIPW with 5-fold cross-fitting
aipw <- ate(y = Y, a = A, x = X, nsplits = 5, sl.lib = SL.library)
print(aipw$res)

# IPW estimates for AIPW
prop_model <- SuperLearner(Y = A, X = X, SL.library = SL.library,
                           family = binomial())
prop_score <- prop_model$SL.predict
ipw_aipw <- ifelse(A == 1, 1 / prop_score, 1 / (1 - prop_score))
summary(ipw_aipw)
mean(ipw_aipw > 5)

# Influence function for AIPW
if_aipw <- aipw$ifvals[[2]] - aipw$ifvals[[1]]
if_aipw_centered <- if_aipw - mean(if_aipw)
summary(if_aipw_centered)

```

```{r 2 TMLE}
# TMLE with 5-fold cross-fitting
tmle_result <- tmle(Y = Y, A = A, W = X, family = 'gaussian',
                    Q.SL.library = SL.library,
                    g.SL.library =SL.library,
                    V.Q = 5,
                    V.g = 5)
print(tmle_result$estimates$ATE)

# IPW estimates for TMLE
g1W <- tmle_result$g$g1W
g0W <- 1 - g1W
ipw_tmle <- ifelse(A == 1, 1 / g1W, 1 / g0W)
summary(ipw_tmle)
mean(ipw_tmle > 5)

# Influence function for TMLE
if_tmle <- (tmle_result$Qstar[,2] - tmle_result$Qstar[,1]) +
  (A / tmle_result$g$g1W - (1 - A) / (1 - tmle_result$g$g1W)) *
  (Y - tmle_result$Qstar[cbind(1:length(Y), A + 1)])
if_tlme_centered <- if_tmle - mean(if_tmle)
summary(if_tlme_centered)

```

```{r 2 simple estimate}
# No covariate adjustment estimate
mean(Y[A == 1]) - mean(Y[A == 0])

```

## Question 3

```{r 3}
# Estimate E[A|W]
fit_A <- SuperLearner(Y = A, X = X, family = binomial(),
                      SL.library = c("SL.glm", "SL.mean"))
EA_W <- fit_A$SL.predict

# Estimate E[Y|W]
fit_Y <- SuperLearner(Y = Y, X = X, family = gaussian(),
                      SL.library = c("SL.glm", "SL.mean"))
EY_W <- fit_Y$SL.predict

# Residuals
resid_A <- A - EA_W
resid_Y <- Y - EY_W

# Efficient influence function
phi <- resid_A * resid_Y

#5 Statistics
theta_hat <- mean(phi)
se_theta <- sd(phi) / sqrt(length(phi))
z_stat <- theta_hat / se_theta
p_value <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_stat)))

#6: results
cat("theta estimate:", theta_hat, "\n")
cat("Standard error:", se_theta, "\n")
cat("p-value:", p_value, "\n")

```

## Question 4

```{r 4 model}
# Fit the R-learner model with 5-fold cross-fitting
set.seed(123)
rboost_fit <- rboost(x = X, w = A, y = Y, k_folds = 5)

# Predict the Conditional Average Treatment Effects (CATEs)
rboost.est <- predict(rboost_fit, newx = X)
```

```{r 4 visualise}
# Histogram of the treatment effect estimates
hist(rboost.est, 
     breaks = 30, 
     main = "Histogram of Treatment Effect Estimates", 
     xlab = "Estimated Treatment Effects (CATE)", 
     col = "grey", 
     border = "black")

par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
# Plot CATEs vs Age
plot(pension$age, rboost.est, 
     xlab = "Age", ylab = "CATE", 
     main = "CATE vs Age", 
     pch = 16, col = "skyblue4")
lines(smooth.spline(pension$age, rboost.est), col = "red", lwd = 2)

# Plot CATEs vs Income
plot(pension$inc, rboost.est, 
     xlab = "Income", ylab = "CATE", 
     main = "CATE vs Income", 
     pch = 16, col = "darkseagreen")
lines(smooth.spline(pension$inc, rboost.est), col = "red", lwd = 2)

# Plot CATEs vs Education
plot(pension$educ, rboost.est, 
     xlab = "Years of Education", ylab = "CATE", 
     main = "CATE vs Education", 
     pch = 16, col = "plum4")
lines(smooth.spline(pension$educ, rboost.est), col = "red", lwd = 2)

# Reset plotting to default layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

```

```{r 4 diagnostics}
# Check IPW's and extreme influence functions
p_hat <- rboost_fit$p_hat           # Estimated propensity scores E[W|X]
pseudo_outcome <- rboost_fit$pseudo_outcome  # (Y - m_hat) / (W - p_hat)
weights <- rboost_fit$weights       # (W - p_hat)^2

# Check stability of inverse probability weights (IPWs)
ipw_treated <- 1 / p_hat
ipw_control <- 1 / (1 - p_hat)

# Summary stats to detect extreme weights
summary(ipw_treated)
summary(ipw_control)

# Visualize distributions
hist(ipw_treated, breaks = 50, main = "IPW Treated (1/p_hat)", xlab = "IPW")
hist(ipw_control, breaks = 50, main = "IPW Control (1/(1-p_hat))", xlab = "IPW")

# Count extreme propensity scores (near 0 or 1)
cat("Number of p_hat < 0.05:", sum(p_hat < 0.05), "\n")
cat("Number of p_hat > 0.95:", sum(p_hat > 0.95), "\n")

# Check for extreme influence functions (outliers in pseudo outcome)
pseudo_mean <- mean(pseudo_outcome)
pseudo_sd <- sd(pseudo_outcome)

# Identify extreme values
extreme_idx <- which(pseudo_outcome < (pseudo_mean - 3 * pseudo_sd) | 
                     pseudo_outcome > (pseudo_mean + 3 * pseudo_sd))

cat("Number of extreme influence function values:", length(extreme_idx), "\n")

# Extreme individuals
head(data.frame(Index = extreme_idx, PseudoOutcome = 
                  pseudo_outcome[extreme_idx]))


```

## Question 5

```{r 5 model}

SL.library <- c("SL.glm", "SL.ranger", "SL.xgboost")

K <- 5
folds <- sample(rep(1:K, length.out = nrow(pension)))
preds <- vector(length = nrow(pension))

# Initialise for loop for cross-fitting
set.seed(454)
for(k in 1:K){
  test <- which(folds == k)
  train <- which(folds != k)
  
  Ytrain_out <- Y[train]
  Atrain_out <- A[train]
  Xtrain_out <- X[train, ]
  Ptrain_out <- P[train, ]
  
  folds2 <- sample(rep(1:K, length.out = length(train)))
  C <- vector(length = length(train))
  
  for(i in 1:K){
    test_in <- which(folds2 == i)
    train_in <- which(folds2 != i)
    
    Ytrain_in <- Ytrain_out[train_in]
    Atrain_in <- Atrain_out[train_in]
    Xtrain_in <- Xtrain_out[train_in, ]
    Ptrain_in <- Ptrain_out[train_in, ]
    
    y_sub <- Ytrain_in[which(Atrain_in == 1)]
    x_sub <- Xtrain_in[which(Atrain_in == 1), ]
    p_sub <- Ptrain_in[which(Atrain_in == 1), ]

    model_y1 <- SuperLearner(Y = y_sub, 
                            X = data.frame(x_sub, p_sub), 
                            SL.library = SL.library)
    
    model_ps <- SuperLearner(Y = Atrain_in, 
                            X = data.frame(Xtrain_in, Ptrain_in), 
                            SL.library = SL.library)
    
    newd <- data.frame(Xtrain_out[test_in, ], Ptrain_out[test_in, ])
    y_hat <- predict(model_y1, newdata = newd)$pred
    ps_hat <- predict(model_ps, newdata = newd)$pred
    
    a_sub <- Atrain_out[test_in]
    y2_sub <- Ytrain_out[test_in]
    C[test_in] <- y_hat + a_sub * (y2_sub - y_hat) / ps_hat
  }
  
  model_C <- SuperLearner(Y = C, 
                               X = data.frame(X[train, ]), 
                               SL.library = SL.library)
  
  preds[test] <- predict(model_C, data.frame(X[test, ]))$pred
}
```

```{r 5 visualise}
# Histogram of predicted counterfactuals
hist(preds, breaks = 50, main = "Predicted counterfactual net financial assets",
     xlab = "Predicted net financial assets if eligible")

```


```{r 5 mse}
# Squared error between what was observed and what was predicted
Y_tilde <- (Y - preds)^2

# Average prediction error using AIPW
aiptw <- ate(y = Y_tilde, a = A, x = X, 
             sl.lib = SL.library, 
             nsplits = 5)
aiptw$res

```
